page.layout: One column of index entries at the top of the page, right of the binding; below it a woodcut garland ornament; lower right a large initial "IN-" starting a new section. The facing page's edge at the far right is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Bonæ fidei quindecim actiones enumeratæ, d. lib. 4. tit. 6. §. actio num. 28.
Locus quo traditur, Seruum noxæ deditum ab eo etiam inuito cu deditus est pecunia data redimi & manumitti posse. d. lib. 4. t. 8 §. dominus. 3.

Lex Hostilia, qua permissum erat Furti agere eorum nomine, qui apud hostes essent, ut Reip. causa abessent, quiue in eorum alicujus tutela essent, d. lib. 4. tit. 10. §. 1. verf. Praterea lege Hostilia
Ratio cur Furti manifesti sit perpetua actio, d. lib. 4. tit. 12. in pr.
Judicia omnia esse absolutoria: d. tit. 12. in fin.

page.notes: The woodcut garland of fruit and foliage between the entries and the "IN-" initial is an ornament, not text. The faint lines below the garland and the faint marks lower on the page appear to be show-through from the other side and are not transcribed. The page number reads as "968" but the top digits are blurred, so it is marked [?]. The "IN-" fragment is cut off by the scan and its continuation is not visible. The line "alicu jus" is split across lines without a printed hyphen, so it is written whole.
